## 보관 원문

> # Electra Jefferson County demonstration facility update
>
> Electra announced on 2025-10-21 that it had unveiled the site of a
> 130,000-square-foot demonstration facility in Jefferson County, Colorado. The
> company described the facility as designed to produce up to 500 metric tonnes
> per year of low-carbon, high-purity iron and said that operations were expected
> to begin in mid-2026.
>
> The announced product specification was 99% pure iron from Electra's
> low-temperature process. The release did not disclose measured demonstration-
> plant current efficiency, electricity intensity, campaign duration, equipment
> availability, electrode life, or achieved annual production.
>
> Electra reported signed purchase commitments for material qualification from
> Nucor, Toyota Tsusho America, and INTERFER Edelstahl Group. Nucor intended to
> qualify the iron in EAF sheet production; Toyota Tsusho and INTERFER intended
> downstream distribution or specialty-steel qualification after successful
> qualification. These commitments are evidence of customer validation work, not
> evidence that the facility had started production or met nameplate capacity.
>
> The company also reported a USD 50 million Breakthrough Energy Catalyst grant,
> an USD 8 million Colorado industrial tax credit, and previously announced
> Series B funding. It stated an objective of reaching commercial-scale clean-
> iron production by the end of the decade.
>
